question_pattern: fyp,final year project,how to start fyp
answer_text: To start your FYP at NED University: 1. Explore past approved projects in the FYP Portal. 2. Shortlist domains and supervisors whose research matches your interests. 3. Form a 3-4 member team. 4. Submit an initial proposal by 7th semester.
If you fail a prerequisite course, you cannot enroll in downstream courses until you pass it. Check the Prerequisite Explorer to see the cascading delays on your graduation timeline.
The minimum passing grade at NED University is D (1.0 grade point). To maintain good academic standing and scholarship eligibility, aim for a CGPA of 3.0 or higher.
Check the Professor Directory on EduCompass. You can review faculty research areas and automatically draft a personalized outreach email to discuss project supervision.
